address: 66/96 Soi Wat Ton Son, Akkanivat Road, Bang Pla Soi, Mueang Chon Buri, Chon Buri, 20000, Thailand
bio: This unassuming noodle joint in a quiet alley offers a different take on yen ta fo with squid egg. The well-seasoned dry kao lao also impresses. The menu is short (and only in Thai) but the cooking is heartfelt, portions are honest, and prices fair. A favourite among locals.
